name: guest area 2
description: a larger guest room that was once clearly intended for a child visitor. a small crib sits in the corner, its blankets moth-eaten and gray. the wallpaper has faded patterns of flowers and teddy bears, now barely visible. a child's drawings are pinned to the wall — crude figures of a family of eight, with one figure drawn in black crayon, crossed out.

exits.description: another door, slightly ajar. a child's voice seems to whisper from within, then falls silent when you focus on it.
